category: Planninq competes as team project and task management inside Nextcloud: projects with members, a kanban board per project with work in progress limits, a backlog, a task page with comments, attachments and dependencies, a per-project Gantt timeline, due reminders, personal time logging with a timesheet, and a capacity and portfolio view across projects, for internal IT, development and project teams in Dutch public organisations. It is project planning and work management. It is not rostering or shift planning (humaniq owns that) and not booking of rooms or equipment. A buyer who already runs Nextcloud compares it first with Nextcloud Deck, which is on the same platform for free, then with the open source project management suites OpenProject, Plane and Kanboard, and with the market leader Jira, which the product's own description names as the complexity it avoids.

capabilities.name: Create a project with a name, a short key and a description.

built.evidence: src/dialogs/ProjectCreationDialog.vue:113-118 (form: title, description, color, icon; no key field) -> src/store/projects.js:328 createProject() -> lib/Controller/ProjectController.php:221 create()
defects: src/dialogs/ProjectCreationDialog.vue:113-118 no field for the schema's `key` property

capabilities.note: title and description work end to end. lib/Settings/planninq_register.json declares a project `key` property ("short unique project key") but no form anywhere exposes it, so a user cannot set a short key at create time.

capabilities.name: Add and remove project members from the organisation's user list.

built.evidence: src/components/ProjectSettingsSidebar.vue:77-113 (Members tab) -> src/components/MemberSearch.vue:120-151 (OCS /ocs/v2.php/cloud/users search) + :160-173 selectUser -> src/store/projects.js:610 addMember() / :672 removeMember()

capabilities.name: Give project members different roles, such as owner and member, with different rights.

built.evidence: lib/Settings/planninq_register.json project schema has only `owner` (string, set once at creation) and `members` (flat array of UIDs, no per-member role). src/components/ProjectSettingsSidebar.vue:83-113 renders the member list with only a Leave/Remove action, no role picker.

capabilities.note: owner vs member is an implicit two-tier RBAC baked into schema authorization rules (update/delete require owner), not something a user assigns, and it cannot be changed except by leaving (ownership handoff in ProjectController.php:290-300). There is no UI or API to give a member elevated rights while staying a member.

capabilities.name: Leave a project you are a member of without asking the owner.

built.evidence: src/components/ProjectSettingsSidebar.vue:99 (Leave project button) -> src/dialogs/ProjectLeaveDialog.vue -> src/store/projects.js:708 leaveProject() -> lib/Controller/ProjectController.php:308 leaveProject()
built.reachedOn: ProjectBoard page, Project settings sidebar, Members tab

capabilities.note: server bypasses OR's owner-only RBAC with _rbac:false after validating membership, and hands ownership to the alphabetically-first remaining member if the owner leaves.

capabilities.name: Archive a finished project and restore it later.

capabilities.name: Filter the project list by status, such as active or archived.

capabilities.name: Start a new project with a ready-made set of board columns.

built.evidence: src/store/projects.js:328/354 createProject() -> createDefaultColumns() (line 469) writes 4 `column` objects (title/order/wipLimit/type) via saveObject(COLUMN_SCHEMA,...). But src/views/ProjectBoard.vue:283-291 builds its columns purely from the hardcoded BOARD_STATUSES status enum (src/utils/taskHelpers.js:252) and never fetches or reads the `column` schema (confirmed: no COLUMN_SCHEMA reference outside src/store/projects.js:28,138-139,476,564,566, which only write/delete it, never read it back for display).
built.reachedOn: nothing renders the created columns; the board a user actually sees is always the same 5 fixed status lanes (Open/In Progress/Blocked/Done/Cancelled) regardless of what was created
defects: src/views/ProjectBoard.vue:283-291 columns() ignores the `column` schema entirely and hardcodes BOARD_STATUSES

src/store/projects.js:96-111 getDefaultColumns() also has a dead admin-override path: it calls loadState('planninq','default_columns', null) but no PHP code anywhere calls provideInitialState for that key (confirmed: zero matches for provideInitialState in lib/), so the admin's configured column titles in src/views/settings/Settings.vue:430-495 never reach the frontend and the hardcoded 4-column fallback is always used

capabilities.note: a new project does get a ready-made set of `column` OpenRegister objects written, but they are dead data: the kanban board the user opens is a hardcoded 5-status board, not driven by those column records at all, so the capability the row describes (a board that starts with a ready-made set of columns) does not actually reach the user.

capabilities.name: Record a project's delivery and billing terms, such as budget and fixed price or hourly billing.

defects: src/components/ProjectSettingsSidebar.vue:16-64 Details tab has no fields for billable/budgetHours/budgetAmount/hourlyRate

capabilities.note: the fields exist and are shown when already set (presumably via import/direct API), but the app itself provides no way to record them, which is the capability the row asks about.
